in_sanskrit.name: जयामिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय (Jaya) meaning victory or triumph + आमिनी (Amini) meaning prosperous or wealth. Thus, Jayaamini means 'Victorious and Prosperous' or 'Triumphant and Wealthy'.

in_hindi.name: जयामिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय (Jaya) meaning victory or triumph + आमिनी (Amini) meaning prosperous or wealth. Thus, Jayaamini means 'Victorious and Prosperous' or 'Triumphant and Wealthy' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: ஜயாமினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜய (Jaya) meaning victory or triumph + அமினி (Amini) meaning prosperous or wealth. Thus, Jayaamini means 'Victorious and Prosperous' or 'Triumphant and Wealthy' in Tamil as well.

in_telugu.name: జెయామీనీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జెయ (Jaya) meaning victory or triumph + మీనీ (Mini) meaning small or little. Thus, Jayaamini means 'Victorious and Small' or 'Triumphant and Little' in Telugu as well.

in_marathi.name: Jayaamini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayaamini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of victory. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jaya’ meaning victory and ‘Mini’ meaning small or Mine. Jayaamini is the goddess of victory and triumph. She is revered for her strength, courage, and wisdom.
